data.long_meaning: Api is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'ap' which means 'to illuminate' or 'to light'. It is a spiritual name and is often given to girls in Hindu traditions to symbolize the inner light and knowledge within them. It is also believed to bring wisdom and clarity. The name Api carries the meaning “Light” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Api usually hope their child will grow to embody light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
